Priyanshu Upadhyay 
Mumbai, Maharashtra | priyanshuu839@gmail.com | +91 7738824875 |  
GitHub: priyanshu20051112 | LinkedIn: priyanshu-builds 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Backend-focused Software Engineer specializing in REST API design, relational database architecture, and modular system 
development. Experienced in building production-ready services utilizing caching strategies, containerization, and strict 
authentication mechanisms. Capable of designing scalable data models and integrating external ML workflows for retrieval-
augmented generation applications. 
 
TECHNICAL SKILLS 
Languages: Python, Java, SQL, C 
Backend: Flask, SQLAlchemy, REST APIs, JWT Authentication 
Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React (Basic) 
 Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Redis, FAISS  
Tools: Git, GitHub, Docker, Postman 
CS Fundamentals: Data Structures, Algorithms, Object-Oriented Programming, DBMS, Operating Systems, Computer Networks 
 
PROJECTS 
 
Crisp 
Live Demo | GitHub 
Flask, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, Redis, Docker 
• Developed a production-style URL shortening service using a modular Flask architecture with Blueprints to cleanly 
separate routing from application logic. 
• Engineered REST API endpoints for custom alias creation and implemented an automated 24-hour database-level expiration 
mechanism for generated links. 
• Integrated Redis for redirect caching and distributed rate limiting to reduce repeated PostgreSQL database lookups and 
prevent API abuse. 
• Containerized the application environment using Docker to ensure consistent deployment configurations across development 
and production states. 
• Utilized SQLAlchemy ORM for database schema management, enabling secure and structured interactions with the PostgreSQL 
backend. 
 
FleetFlow 
Flask, React, MySQL, JWT Authentication 
• Built a comprehensive fleet management system exposing REST API endpoints to structurally manage vehicles, trips, drivers, 
maintenance logs, and expenses. 
• Implemented JWT-based authentication and role-based access control (RBAC) to enforce secure routing and strict 
authorization across user sessions. 
• Designed a normalized MySQL relational database schema utilizing foreign keys across 6 tables to maintain data integrity for 
real-time operational tracking. 
• Connected a React frontend dashboard to backend services, handling state management and API requests to facilitate 
administrative workflows. 
 
AI Document Assistant 
Flask, LangChain, FAISS, SQLAlchemy, OpenRouter API 
• Constructed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline for PDF documents, allowing users to perform semantic search 
and contextual question answering. 
• Implemented text chunking logic and generated vector embeddings utilizing the BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 model to capture 
semantic meaning from uploads. 
• Integrated the FAISS vector database to execute in-memory similarity searches, instantly retrieving highly relevant 
document chunks based on user query embeddings. 
• Orchestrated connections between the LangChain framework and OpenRouter API to construct prompts and generate 
responses grounded strictly in retrieved data. 

• Managed application state and document metadata storage using SQLAlchemy to securely maintain associations 
between concurrent users and their uploaded files. 
 
EDUCATION 
A.P. Shah Institute of Technology 
Expected Graduation: 2028 
Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.), Computer Science Engineering (Specialization in AI & ML) 
CGPA: 9.34 / 10 
 
ACHIEVEMENTS 
• Semi-finalist, Nakshatra Hackathon
